entities.name: Protocol Discriminator
entities.description: A field in the NAS message header that identifies the protocol type. For EPS mobility management messages, it is encoded as 'EPS mobility management messages'.

entities.name: NAS message
entities.description: A Non-Access Stratum message that can be security protected and contains a protocol discriminator in its header.

entities.name: EPS mobility management messages
entities.description: The specific encoding value used for the protocol discriminator in EPS NAS messages.

relations.description: NAS messages contain a protocol discriminator in their header.
The protocol discriminator is encoded as 'EPS mobility management messages' for EPS NAS messages.
The protocol discriminator and its use are defined in 3GPP TS 24.007.
